turnout.notes: Illinois turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. A July 5, 2026 review of the official Illinois State Board of Elections by-office precinct CSVs found Registration and VoteCount fields but no valid turnout replacement: statewide Registration sums to 7,210,422 versus 8,970,541 EAC registered voters, 2,260 precinct keys have zero Registration, and President contest totals including over/under/blank rows are 14,371 below EAC ballots cast.

reviewCharts.warning: Illinois review rows compare official precinct President rows with U.S. House rows where the jurisdiction/precinct key is unambiguous and the House contest has both Democratic and Republican candidate votes. Rows are omitted for precinct keys appearing in multiple House districts and for uncontested or one-party House comparison rows. This is an advisory same-election comparison, not a statewide Senate or Governor comparison.

historicalBaselines.warning: Illinois historical baseline rows come from official State Board of Elections Candidate Totals by County workbooks. They include candidate and write-in votes but exclude blank, undervote, and overvote records that are not present in those workbooks. Pre-promotion reconciliation is pinned in data/il-historical-promotion-reconciliation.json: all 102 live 2020 tags are preserved, 100 vote tuples change, and McLean and Winnebago correct from incomplete red winners to official blue winners. Use these rows as contextual jurisdictionTag flip baselines, not as 2024 certified-result rows. Official 2012 county baselines remain uncollected.
